_about: Registry-driven config for fetch_diavgeia.py — keeps COUNTRY + terms + host OUT of engine logic (EXTRACTION_PLAYBOOK §6.6). Add a country by adding a block here; the fetcher stays country-agnostic.
_filter_param_note: PLAYBOOK §1: proven to filter (gibberish subject= -> total 0; unfiltered -> 3.1M). The q=/query= params are DECORATION.
_control_term_note: PLAYBOOK §6.2: a common word that MUST return >0; if it returns 0 the API/param is broken and the sweep aborts instead of reporting a false empty.
_exclude_note: Relevance noise dropped BEFORE storing (municipal bank-fee accounting, not tenders). Every drop is announced (PLAYBOOK §6.4).
